## Checklist

- [ ] Claims are cited in `docs/sources.md` with a confidence note
- [ ] Bilingual parity considered (`README.md` ↔ `README.zh-CN.md`)
- [ ] If the skill changed: `quick_validate.py skill/ai-first-cli` passes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated if this is a notable change
- [ ] Honest about uncertainty — no unsourced claim presented as fact
